Known for energetic bass-driven performances and a distinctive stage presence, LOLLY seamlessly blends Bass, Drum & Bass, Jersey Club, Trap, Bounce, Midtempo, House, and other electronic music genres. With dynamic track selection and smooth transitions, LOLLY consistently delivers performances that captivate audiences from start to finish. After completing the Music Production Program at AES Myanmar, LOLLY has continued to create and release original tracks and remixes.
